tip:
If the database is PostgreSQL, arrays, collections, intervals (Duration, Period) and range types (PgRange<T>) are mapped by PostgreSQL JDBC mappers.
1. Add Gradle dependency: implementation("io.koraframework:database-jdbc-postgres")
2. Extend the @KoraApp interface with io.koraframework.database.jdbc.postgres.PostgresJdbcDatabaseModule instead of io.koraframework.database.jdbc.JdbcDatabaseModule
3. Mark the entity field or repository method parameter with @io.koraframework.database.jdbc.postgres.annotation.Pg, PostgreSQL mappers are applied only where this tag is present

If this is a PostgreSQL json or jsonb column, PostgreSQL JDBC mappers can store the value as JSON.
1. Add Gradle dependency: implementation("io.koraframework:database-jdbc-postgres")
2. Extend the @KoraApp interface with io.koraframework.database.jdbc.postgres.PostgresJdbcDatabaseModule
3. Mark the entity field or repository method parameter with @io.koraframework.database.jdbc.postgres.annotation.PgJson or @io.koraframework.database.jdbc.postgres.annotation.PgJsonb and make sure JsonWriter<T> / JsonReader<T> exist for the value type
